question: The famous physicist Victor Franz Hess is known for the discovery of:
solution:
The correct answer is __**cosmic radiation.** __

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **Cosmic Radiation:-**

 
 
• **These are high-energy particles that travel through space and bombard Earth's atmosphere. **
 
• **They were discovered by Victor Franz Hess in 1912, when he made a series of balloon ascents to measure the ionization of the atmosphere at different altitudes. (Hence option 1 is correct).**
 
• He found that the ionization increased with altitude, even though the atmosphere becomes less dense at higher altitudes.
 
• This led him to conclude that there must be a source of radiation coming from outside the atmosphere.
 
 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Quantum statistics:-**

 
 
• It is the application of statistical mechanics to quantum mechanical systems.
 
• **It describes the behavior of large ensembles of identical quantum particles, taking into account the restrictions imposed by quantum mechanics, such as the Pauli exclusion principle and the wave-like nature of matter.**
 
 
 
• **Expanding universe:-**
 
 
• It is one of the most important discoveries in modern physics.
 
• **It was first proposed by Edwin Hubble in the 1920s, and it has since been confirmed by many other observations.**
 
 
 
• **Theory of Superconductivity:-**
 
 
• It is a microscopic theory that explains the phenomenon of superconductivity.
 
• **Superconductivity is the ability of certain materials to conduct electricity without resistance and to expel magnetic fields below a certain critical temperature.**
